title: Noncommutative maximal weak type $(1,1)$ estimates for convolution operators under $L_1$-Hörmander conditions
summary: We prove weak type $(1,1)$ estimates for families of scalar convolution operators acting on operator-valued function spaces. A joint $L_1$-Hörmander condition, together with a maximal strong type estimate at one exponent $1<r\leq\infty$, suffices. The kernels may be complex-valued and need not have uniformly bounded $L_1$ norms. Under a size condition, the result also yields a weak endpoint estimate for all sharp truncation radii of singular kernels. This resolves, for convolution kernels, the problem mentioned in \cite[Remark~5.5]{parcet09pseudo} and recalled in Parcet's recent survey…
